bio_en: Nshan Nahikian was born in August 1883 in Huseynik near Kharpert, the son of a doctor. In the Hamidian massacre of 1895, aged twelve, he witnessed the torture and killing of his father and of two sisters and two brothers, and was cared for in a French hospital, where patriotism took root in him. He became a doctor and a leading ARF figure of the Kharpert region. In 1915 he was among the prisoners who resisted and were burned alive in the Mezre prison of Kharpert on 4 August 1915.
